title: Maiolica – Venus and Cupid swimming on dolphins, 5 Euro
descriptionPlain: Description New release in euro in collaboration with the Central Bank of Malta Insert crafted by Polish Porcelain Factories “Ćmielów” and “Chodzież” Limited edition with individual edge numbering Inspired by the grace and rich symbolism of Renaissance art, this coin captures the timeless beauty of Venus accompanied by Cupid, sailing on dolphins across the mythical seas. A story of love, harmony, and the eternal journey of life comes to life through the artistry of the Renaissance, reflected in the delicate porcelain insert handcrafted by Polish Porcelain Factories “Ćmielów” and “Chodzież”. Art enables us to find ourselves and lose ourselves at the same time. Thomas Merton
